caption: The drawing depicts a hand bellows, an object used for blowing air into a fire. The bellows consist of two handles made of wood, each colored a light brown with visible wood grain texture. The main body of the bellows is a large, rounded shape, primarily tan brown in color, with a decorative floral pattern on the surface. The pattern includes two large red circular shapes with surrounding leafy elements, accented with green and gold tones. Around the perimeter of the main part, there is a dark blue border featuring a repeating motif of yellow and white star-like flowers. The side of the bellows is shown in a soft pinkish brown color, held together with regularly spaced metal studs. The nozzle at the bottom is metallic and gold in color, showing a turned, cylindrical form with several segmented rings. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or design elements.
title: Bellows
